subject: general
question: The emergency brake bypasses which system and locks the wheels?
solution:
The correct answer is __Hydraulic brake system.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hydraulic brake system__ is widely used in vehicles to ensure effective braking.
 
• It works by transmitting force through a fluid medium to activate the brakes.
 
• Hydraulic brakes provide better control and responsiveness compared to mechanical systems.
 
• The fluid used in hydraulic systems is non-compressible, ensuring consistent performance.
 
• They are designed to distribute braking force evenly across all wheels.
 
• Hydraulic brake systems have a self-energizing property that enhances braking efficiency.
 
• Regular maintenance, including fluid replacement, is necessary to prevent system failure.
 
• These systems are commonly found in modern cars, trucks, and motorcycles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric Brake System:**

 
 
• Uses electrical signals to activate braking mechanisms.
 
• Commonly used in trains and aircraft.
 
 
 
• **Air Pressure System:**
 
 
• Operates using compressed air to apply brake force.
 
• Widely used in heavy-duty vehicles like trucks and buses.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Injection System:**
 
 
• Related to engine performance and fuel delivery.
 
• Not involved in the braking process.
